findings.reason: the coordinator would dispatch §6 and §10 in parallel on a false disjointness claim, and the plan needs a depends-on edge (and the matching followup wording) serializing one after the other.
findings.text: `plan-section-depends-on` carries no edge between s6 and s10 and f-jlr-002 states the two "write disjoint files and can run together", but §6's write paths name `reckon/crew/paid_lanes.py` (the run-home search only) and §10's write paths name `reckon/crew/paid_lanes.py`, so dispatching the wave as the followup orders it puts two workers in one file concurrently

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: pass — every anchor in the in-scope units resolves: the splice at `reckon/crew/picker/__init__.py:456` and `htmlsafe_json_dumps` at :276/:295, `build_state` at `reckon/crew/picker/prompts.py:211`, `_compose_budget_report`/`_reage_budget_report`/`budget_view` in `snapshot.py`, `_budget_block` in `lane_context.py`, `compose_document`/`REFRESH_INTERVAL` in `paid_lanes.py`, `lane-and-model-routing` §27 (which does write `lane_context.py` and `prompts.py`), the cited review total 97 (18+16+17+18+16+12), and the evidence page `docs/evidence/archive/jev-learns-from-its-routes-landed.html`.
rubric_items.done_when: pass — §9, §10 and §11 each name a negative control that can fail (restore "never stale by age"; omit the published shelf-life key; restore the post-render splice), and each names the assertion that must then fail.
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — no in-scope section places evidence in a session scratchpad or a node-local temporary path; §10's assertion runs through the landed `lane_context._budget_block`, and the landed record is the archive page named in the close comments.
rubric_items.naming: pass — no plan labels, stage names, ticket numbers or version tags reach the new symbols (`suggested_shelf_life_seconds`, the tests' file names, `build_state`), and no changelog prose.
rubric_items.reasoning: pass — each in-scope mechanism produces its done-when on the real path: §9's rule is computed by the single owner `lane_context._budget_block` (`snapshot.py:535`, `:611`) whose `expired` flag feeds the ceiling gate at `snapshot.py:890-897`; §10 adds the top-level `suggested_shelf_life_seconds` that `lane_context._document_shelf_life_seconds` reads; §11 moves the assessment into `build_state`, the state's encoder, deleting the splice at `picker/__init__.py:456`. The stated root causes match the code: `compose_document` returns no shelf-life key, and the splice exists as described.
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — §9 (account-surface reading ages from its probe), §10 (the document states its own shelf life) and §11 (one encoder owns the state) each carry one deliverable with one verdict.
rubric_items.wiring: a finding — f-jlr-002 declares §3, §6, §7, §8 and §10 write disjoint files and can run together, but §6 and §10 both write `reckon/crew/paid_lanes.py`, and no `plan-section-depends-on` edge serializes them.
